$comment: Seed workspaces of the shipped design (v5). Generated — do not hand-edit; rerun scripts/extract-design.mjs.

provenance.method: evaluated: class Component from <script data-dc-script> run in node:vm with a DCLogic/React/localStorage shim (lib/load-dc.mjs)

notes: v5 seeds THREE workspaces: bluetokai (built-in template, live v7 / draft v8), starbucks and burgerking (draft v1, derived from Blue Tokai by replaying the steps listed under replaySteps).
thirdwave and chaayos are NOT v5 workspaces: they appear only as picker entries in v2/v3 (see legacyWorkspaces). They carry no tenant-specific data.
Quirk: in v5 seed(<unknown id>) falls through to the Burger King replay, and ws() falls back to bluetokai — see quirks.
document = stashOf(state): the exact per-workspace object v5 persists (modules, perms, live, liveV, draftV, history).
Element ids (f_N, s_N, ns_N, ni_N) come from a per-class counter and are only stable within one generation run.

replaySteps.title: Rename BD, narrow its approval
replaySteps.detail: BD becomes BP – Site identification. Its details approval is renamed Property Committee (CEO / CPO) and narrowed to business admin — CEO and CPO approve by holding that role, which is why this carries G4.

replaySteps.title: Rename Legal, name the checklist slot
replaySteps.detail: Legal & Compliance becomes Legal / Statutory. Checklist slot 1 is named RERA / statutory feasibility — a built-in slot, renamed, not a new field.

replaySteps.title: Rename Finance / CA
replaySteps.detail: Finance / CA approval becomes Finance – for budget: project cost, legal cost and other costs.

replaySteps.title: Try to turn built-in Design off
replaySteps.detail: Refused: “Project can’t start until Design is approved.” The configurator offers Edit Project’s gate — which is exactly what the next two steps do.

replaySteps.title: Create custom module Store Design
replaySteps.detail: Four stages through the wizard: Measurement → Asia Pacific review → Peer design → Final design, gated on Legal cleared. Signed off by the Asia Pacific and Starbucks design teams.

replaySteps.title: Move the JOIN to Execution
replaySteps.detail: Project’s gate becomes final design approved AND budget approved. The JOIN marker moves from Design down to Execution — this is the whole difference between the two flows. With nothing depending on them any more, built-in Design and Project Excellence can now be turned off.

replaySteps.title: Rename the QA milestone
replaySteps.detail: Project’s Quality audit milestone becomes QA team – quality audit. Same built-in stage, tenant’s words.

replaySteps.title: Create Audit by QA & NSO
replaySteps.detail: A joint audit signed off by two teams. The platform can only name tiers inside one module, so this carries G1 until team approvers ship.

replaySteps.title: Create close snags → Operations HOC
replaySteps.detail: Two more custom modules: Project – close snags, then Operations HOC, the handover to operations.

replaySteps.title: Re-gate Launch on Operations HOC
replaySteps.detail: Launch approval becomes New café launch and waits on the custom handover instead of NSO. Launch is hard-wired to follow NSO today — hence G3.

replaySteps.title: Rename Financial Closure
replaySteps.detail: Financial Closure becomes Post launch: Finance validates the cost, then the CPO approves the final cost.

replaySteps.title: Publish v1
replaySteps.detail: The review sheet lists every change and the three planned capabilities, and asks for a reason. Blue Tokai is untouched — it stays on v7.

replaySteps.title: Rename BD, narrow its approval
replaySteps.detail: BD becomes BP-1 – Site identification, and its details approval becomes Property Committee (with CEO / CPO), narrowed to business admin. G4 again: committee members hold the business admin role.

replaySteps.title: Rename Legal / Statutory
replaySteps.detail: One statutory module covering RERA / statutory approvals, agreements, executions, registrations and licensing.

replaySteps.title: Create custom module Store Design
replaySteps.detail: Five stages: Design → Measurement → Asia Pacific → Peer design + Getin team → Final design. Final design needs four parties to sign — Asia Pacific, Business Administration, Central Design, Signage Design — so it carries G1.

replaySteps.title: Budget moves after design — the branch disappears
replaySteps.detail: Project Excellence becomes Finalise – for budget and is re-gated on final design. Built-in Design and Finance / CA both switch off, and with them the parallel branch: the graph becomes one straight line.

replaySteps.title: Execution waits on the budget
replaySteps.detail: Project execution becomes Project team – execution, gated on budget approved. Sequential, with no join anywhere in the flow.

replaySteps.title: Rename NSO to HSO team
replaySteps.detail: Same supervisor-only built-in module, the tenant’s name for it.

replaySteps.title: Create Audit by BA & HSO
replaySteps.detail: The same two-team sign-off problem as Starbucks, so the same G1 badge.

replaySteps.title: Create Project to closure → Operations HOC
replaySteps.detail: Two custom modules close out the build and hand the store to operations.

replaySteps.title: Re-gate Launch on Operations HOC
replaySteps.detail: New café launch opens after the operations handover rather than after NSO — G3.

replaySteps.title: Rename Financial Closure
replaySteps.detail: Post launch: Finance validates the cost, the CPO signs the final project closure.

replaySteps.title: Publish v1
replaySteps.detail: The review sheet lists every change and the three planned capabilities. Blue Tokai is untouched — it stays on v7.
